data.name: Aminiyyat
data.gender_notes: Aminiyyat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from 'Amin' meaning 'Trustworthy' and 'Suffix 'iyya' meaning 'Girl'. This name signifies a girl who is faithful, trustworthy, and reliable. The name Aminiyyat carries the meaning “Trustworthy, faithful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aminiyyat usually hope their child will grow to embody trustworthy, faithful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: This name holds spiritual significance as it is derived from the name of Prophet Ibrahim (AS) who was known as 'Amin' for his trustworthiness and faithfulness.
data.etymology: Aminiyyat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Trustworthy, faithful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aminiyyat total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
